description:
## Goal

Complete standing coverage of the interpreter's shared foreign argument-shape dispatcher using actual foreign functions with exactly matching prototypes. Reuse the scalar/boolean/aggregate return fixtures established by fz-5xp.30 and the physical signature rules closed by .32.

## Existing evidence

The original audit found dispatch_shapes in src/ir_interp/extern_call.rs enumerating all integer/float argument-bank assignments through MAX_INTERP_EXTERN_ARGS=4 (31 total shapes), while behavior/extern_float_lanes exercised five. Recount after .30/.32; do not freeze obsolete counts or duplicate cases already covered there.

The former strategy of declaring libc functions with extra arguments is withdrawn. A callee ignoring some registers on a tested ABI does not make a mismatched declaration a truthful C/Rust function prototype. Fixtures must not rely on undefined or platform-accidental mismatched calls.

## Strategy

1. Inspect the current shared dispatcher and predecessor tests; enumerate only uncovered supported argument/return shape combinations. .30 owns mandatory tests for its new aggregate feature; this ticket is not permission to defer those.
2. Use small dedicated C or repr(C) exported test functions whose physical signatures exactly match their Fz declarations. Give each argument a distinguishable contribution to the answer so a register-bank/order error cannot pass.
3. Reuse one bounded fixture generator/table if it reduces duplication. Preserve scalar, boolean and scalar-pair result checks across appropriate physical ABI classes without building an enormous mechanically repeated compiler matrix.
4. Exercise interpreter, JIT and AOT and the supported target ABIs. Negative declarations must be rejected before calling, not used to probe whether a foreign callee happens to tolerate them.

## Acceptance

Each supported argument-bank position and arity is meaningfully covered; swapped or dropped arguments produce a failing observable value. Existing exact aggregate and boolean ABI tests remain the authority for their covered cases. No duplicate compilation merely to count the same behavior twice. Documentation states the actual supported shapes and test strategy.

Run focused and full relevant gates; use a fresh cold Sol-high ticket-scoped review before one commit/close and prompt stack push. Discuss the bounded test plan before implementation; use Astra only with explicit permission.

## Order

fz-5xp.30 -> fz-5xp.32 -> this ticket. It is independent of .20 wrapper inlining and kdt.28 proper exceptions. It does not broaden extern arity limits, introduce aggregate parameters, or change the C ABI.
title: Cover the remaining extern argument shapes with exact foreign prototypes
